title: Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships - Third Derivative
description:
Job Description:
Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships

Third Derivative Overview
Third Derivative (D3), a program of RMI , accelerates climate innovation by bringing together startups, investors, corporations, and technical and market experts to help promising climate technologies reach commercial scale.
Through our global accelerator and broader ecosystem, D3 works with hundreds of climate technology companies across major emissions sectors and a network of leading venture investors, corporations, and other capital providers.
Access to the right type of capital at the right stage is one of the most important challenges facing climate technology companies. D3 is building a comprehensive approach to helping startups navigate that challenge-supporting companies in developing effective capital strategies, connecting them with relevant investors and funding partners, and developing new capital solutions where gaps exist.
We are seeking a Senior Associate to help drive this work.

Position Overview
The Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships will help D3 startups access the capital they need to grow and scale.
Working across D3's portfolio, the Senior Associate will identify companies' financing needs and help develop and deliver the right solutions. This may mean working directly with founders to develop their fundraising strategy and connecting them with relevant investors and capital providers; or, where existing sources of capital do not adequately meet portfolio needs, helping D3 design and launch new financing solutions, partnerships, or investment vehicles.
The role sits at the intersection of startup finance, investor engagement, and capital innovation. The Senior Associate will develop a strong understanding of both startup financing needs and capital-provider mandates and use those insights to connect the two-and to identify where new solutions are needed.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver capital solutions to D3 startups

• Work directly with D3 startups to understand their financing needs, readiness, and potential capital pathways.

• Advise founders on fundraising strategy, including the appropriate type and timing of capital, investor targeting, financing trade-offs, and preparation for investor conversations.

• Connect startups with relevant investors and capital providers across venture equity, strategic capital, debt, project finance, non-dilutive and catalytic capital, and other financing pathways.

• Help companies understand investor requirements and what needs to be true to successfully access different forms of capital.

• Track portfolio financing needs and outcomes to identify recurring challenges and opportunities for D3 to provide additional support.
Build and activate the capital ecosystem

• Develop and deepen relationships with investors and capital providers relevant to D3 startups.

• Build a strong understanding of investor mandates, investment criteria, and emerging areas of interest to enable targeted, high-quality introductions.

• Create opportunities for meaningful engagement between D3 startups and capital partners, including curated introductions, investor sessions, and other targeted programming.

• Use insights from investors and startups to identify gaps between the capital available in the market and the financing needs of climate technology companies.
Support D3’s investment and capital solutions strategy

• Support the deployment and management of D3’s existing investment vehicles and contribute an investor perspective to startup selection and portfolio strategy.

• Track portfolio financing needs and outcomes to identify recurring capital gaps and opportunities for D3 to provide additional support.

• Where relevant, research and evaluate potential new capital solutions, partnerships, or investment vehicles that respond to portfolio needs.

• Support the design, fundraising, structuring, and implementation of new capital initiatives as opportunities emerge.

As AI becomes capable of doing more useful work, the way people access and pay for it needs to evolve. Monetization Platform is a new team within Growth building the systems and experiences that make that possible across the entire suite of OpenAI products. Our mission is to make powerful AI easier to access, its value easier to understand, and new ways of using it easier to bring to market.

We work where product experience, platform architecture, and business strategy meet. A new plan or pricing model can change what customers can accomplish-and requires careful engineering across eligibility, entitlements, usage, and subscriptions. We turn that complexity into capabilities that product teams can build on and experiences that customers can trust.

Working with Product, Design, Finance, Financial Engineering, and Data Science, we’re shaping a platform that can evolve alongside our models and products. This is an opportunity to help define a new team’s technical direction and build systems that expand what OpenAI can offer.

You’ll help decide what to build, establish the architecture, and carry ideas through to working products-from a customer’s first interaction with a plan to the services that determine what they can access and use.

- Design integrations with Financial Engineering that preserve correct access and subscription state through plan changes, migrations, asynchronous updates, and partial failures.

- Build reusable components and configuration tools that let teams launch offerings with less custom engineering and fewer dependencies.

- Take responsibility for production quality through migration planning, staged rollouts, testing, monitoring, and recovery paths.

- Shape the technical roadmap, make clear tradeoffs between immediate launches and shared foundations, and develop other engineers through code and design reviews.

- Have taken loosely defined customer or business problems through discovery, implementation, and production operation.

- Combine product intuition with experimentation and analysis, and care about whether customers understand and benefit from what you build.

AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business within your territory, focusing on building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across various personas within an account. You will play a crucial role in expanding our customer base and ensuring successful sales outcomes through effective pipeline generation and accurate sales forecasting.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Sales Forecasting: Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts (+/- 10 of goal), leveraging data to inform decision-making and ensure predictable revenue outcomes with the goal of consistent attainment of revenue targets.

- Process: Drive the sales process through Pipeline Generation (PG), 3 Why’s, Champion Building, MEDDICC, Command of the Message, etc. Maintain account integrity and opportunity data within company systems; Salesforce.

QUALIFICATIONS

You have a love for working in a fast-paced environment and taking the initiative to get stuff done and try new things. You are passionate about powering new possibilities in biotech faster.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase Storage https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything.

We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all!

You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing.

- Improving our analytics bucket offering and improving the storage of open file formats like iceberg and ducklake

- Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications

- Building out our edge network to speed up uploads and build features like automatic cache invalidation

- Solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

- Direct experience designing and operating large file upload/download pipelines at scale

title: Backend Developer
description:
About the role
We are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.
This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy: you’ll take a bug report or change request, investigate it across the codebase, and see it through to production. You’ll balance production support with feature engineering, backed by a supportive team, and we’re embracing agentic development with AI coding agents to ship efficiently without compromising quality.
Key responsibilities

• Resolve production issues: Triage, diagnose, and resolve issues across distributed microservices, tracing a request from the user-facing API down to the services that talk to external systems.

• Support incident response: Investigate root causes, apply fixes, add regression tests, and document findings so issues don’t recur

• Deliver enhancements: Build improvements to existing services, including new versions of certification programs, scorecard and scoring changes, payment adjustments, and integration updates

• Work within the architecture: Follow established patterns and shared internal libraries in a layered service architecture, from the API gateway through the business logic services down to the adapters that integrate with external systems

• Maintain integrations: Maintain and extend integrations with external platforms for performance data, CRM, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payment processing, email, and cloud file storage

• Manage data changes: Write and update database migration scripts and investigate data-related production issues carefully against live data

• Partner with QA and product: Answer testers’ questions, clarify expected behavior, help reproduce issues, and support verification so fixes and features can be signed off smoothly. Ask product clarifying questions early and confirm intent and edge cases

• Improve observability and documentation: Contribute structured logging, masking of sensitive data, and clearer production visibility, and take part in code review while keeping documentation current as the platform grows

Required qualifications

• Proven ability to take ownership of a problem from start to finish, from initial bug report or change request through to a tested, deployed solution

• Production experience building and maintaining backend services with Node.js and TypeScript

• Strong experience with NestJS (or a comparable structured backend framework), including modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, and middleware

• Solid REST/HTTP fundamentals, including service-to-service communication, API contracts, versioning, and error handling

• Comfortable with relational databases, writing and reviewing PostgreSQL queries, and safe migration practices

• Experience debugging distributed systems where a single feature spans several services, reading logs and metrics to find root causes rather than symptoms

• Sound judgment about risk, including the difference between a safe local fix and a change that calls for a rollout plan, particularly for payments, authentication, and live data

• Experience integrating third-party systems (payment providers, CRMs, ERPs, identity providers) behind a clean internal interface

• Understanding of authentication patterns: OAuth 2.0, JWT verification, single sign-on (SSO), and service-to-service (machine-to-machine) authentication

• Comfortable with agentic development, using AI coding agents and tooling to investigate, build, and ship work efficiently while keeping a careful eye on quality

• Ability to write tests that confirm fixes and prevent regressions

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear status updates, incident notes, pull request descriptions, and documentation others can act on

Nice to have

• Experience supporting a platform through the transition from active build to maintenance-and-enhancement mode

• Familiarity

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.   The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role On the device, close to the metal, we write the runtime software that orchestrates work across the chip and runs performance-critical ML kernels. This is where performance gets real and the wins compound. Your work directly influences trade-offs for the silicon, system deployment, and the compiler. You'll drive the first accelerator compute runs, evaluating performance on silicon, running early benchmarks, and feeding results back into the hardware and software roadmap. What you’ll do Write and optimise performance-critical ML kernels

title: Senior Product Manager, Data

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Role

The core of Mixpanel’s value to customers has always been great data. We’re in an exciting moment for the way our users are thinking about and working with product data, and we need help figuring out how our position in the data infrastructure stack evolves. That’s why we’re hiring a fantastic Product Manager for Mixpanel Data.

In this role, you'll own Mixpanel's strategy and roadmap for where we sit in the data landscape - how our data architecture evolves, where we build versus integrate versus get out of the way, and what it means for Mixpanel to work with data that increasingly lives outside our walls as well as inside them. This is a pathfinding role: a large part of the job is turning ambiguous technical and business tradeoffs into a clear point of view, a roadmap, and decisions the engineering and leadership team can act on.

What You'll Do

• Define and drive Mixpanel's strategy and roadmap for how the product evolves alongside customers' data warehouses, lakes, and the broader modern data stack

• Turn complex, ambiguous architecture and business tradeoffs into a clear recommendation, grounded in customer evidence, competitive context, and business impact

• Partner closely with engineering leadership on build-vs-integrate-vs-partner decisions that shape Mixpanel's data architecture for years to come

• Talk directly to customers and prospects to understand how their data infrastructure and workflows are changing, and translate that into product bets

• Build the business case for infrastructure-level investments, making the ROI of foundational, long-horizon work legible to leadership

• Define how Mixpanel's data model, governance, and metadata need to evolve to support deeper analysis and a growing product portfolio

• Align engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a shared strategic point of view, with clear, written communication

• Define and track the metrics that tell you whether the strategy is working, and course-correct as new evidence comes in

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of hands-on product management experience, including ownership of technically complex, infrastructure- or platform-level problems

• Direct experience with the modern data stack - data warehouses, data lakes, ETL/ELT, or data platform tooling - as a builder, user, or product owner

• Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a track record of synthesizing competing technical and business inputs into a clear strategic point of view

• Experience partnering closely with engineering on architecture-level tradeoffs, not just feature scoping

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring technical and non-technical audiences along on a strategic narrative

• Experience using AI tools in product management workflows (e.g., competitive research, prototyping)

Nice to Have

• Experience at a data infrastructure, data platform, or analytics company

• Experience writing production-grade software

• Experience designing products using tools like Figma, Sketch, or Abstract

We've raised a Series A ($50M) and we're headquartered in London, with a team across Belgium and the US. We hold ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, with ISO 42001 in progress.

- AI-first, genuinely. We use AI across the whole company, not just in the product.

- Automate the boring parts. If a process runs often, it shouldn't be manual.

- Distributed by design. Being in a different time zone from your colleagues shouldn't be a handicap.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a global IT role, based in New York.

You'd be the second person on Conveo's IT team, working alongside our IT Manager in London and reporting to him. You'd take day-to-day ownership of support, devices, access and the office - freeing the IT Manager to focus on strategy, security and governance.

Why New York? Presence and coverage. Our US team is growing, and they should be able to reach someone in their own hours rather than wait for the next London morning. With one of us in each region, IT's combined working day stretches across both.

- Own office AV, meeting booths and hardware, and hold the standard that calls start on time without anyone fiddling with cables

- Shape the office into somewhere people choose to come, because collaborating there is easier than doing it from home

- Design the processes that repeat - onboarding, access requests, provisioning

- Operate the IT controls that sit behind ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001 - access reviews, evidence collection, joiner-mover-leaver records, so audits are seamless rather than a scramble

- Help answer customer security questionnaires and vendor assessments. Clear, accurate answers about how we actually run things.

description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture Snap Fusion develops a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy. We are a small team of physicists and engineers. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high. Our findings feed into research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for Physics and quantum technologies. Some problems are too important not to solve. Your mission Lead the nuclear theory behind a new approach to fusion energy. At Snap Fusion, we are pursuing a bold mission: developing a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy. Parts of our roadmap rest on questions of low-energy nuclear physics. Some of these have clear answers in the literature; others turn out, on close reading, to be less settled than they first appear. Knowing which is which matters to us, because it shapes what we build and what we test. We are therefore establishing an in-house nuclear theory effort, and we are looking for a senior few-body theorist to lead it. Your job will be to decide which of our questions current theory can actually answer, to answer those at a standard that would hold up to expert review, and to say plainly where the uncertainties lie. This is an unusual setting for a theorist, in a good way: the questions are concrete, the team is small, and your conclusions will be acted on. What you will do You will work directly with the founders as theory lead. title: Business Operations Coordinator
description:
Fleetworthy offers the only complete technology suite for fleet readiness, uniting safety and compliance, toll management, and weigh station bypass solutions. We help fleets streamline operations, control costs, and operate with confidence. Trusted by 75% of the top fleets in North America, Fleetworthy offers the most adopted toll management solution and largest weigh station bypass network. Going beyond regulatory requirements, our safety and compliance capabilities strengthen safety programs and enable proactive audit readiness. We support millions of vehicles and drivers and are recognized across the industry for innovation and leadership. Fleetworthy is shaping the future of fleet readiness with AI-enabled, connected fleet technology that keeps drivers safe, fleets compliant, and operations running at peak efficiency. Learn more at .

Job Purpose
The Business Operations Coordinator is an entry-level, high-potential role built for a natural systems thinker; someone who's energized by figuring out how the pieces of a complex process connect. Using our CRM and internal data and reporting tools, the Coordinator investigates escalated customer and provider partner issues, digs past the symptom to find the root cause, and partners with toll agencies and internal teams to fix not just the individual case but the process behind it.
Deep tolling industry knowledge isn't required on day one; strong analytical instincts and a comfort with technology and data are. This role is designed to build both, developing the Coordinator into a go-to technical troubleshooter within Business Operations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Investigates escalated customer and provider issues using CRM and internal data tools, tracing each issue to its root cause rather than treating symptoms alone.

• Approaches problems systemically - mapping how provider data, agency processes, and internal workflows connect to identify where breakdowns actually start.

• Analyzes case and usage data to spot patterns across issues, surfacing recurring problems and revenue-loss or violation risk before they grow.

• Collaborates and liaises with Operations and providers to help define technical requirements and provide domain expertise in pursuit of issue closure and continuous process improvement.

• Partners with Operations, Development, and Product to recommend fixes; a process change, a new report or dashboard, or a product enhancement - accomplished through new technology or alternative use of existing technology.

• Documents findings and recommendations clearly enough for teammates, managers, and product owners to act on.

• Engages with customers on an as-needed basis.

• Maintains broad knowledge about the company's services.
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of task activities and/or duties that are required of the employee for this job. Responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Experience and Competencies
This is an entry-level position- we're hiring for mindset and potential, not a resume.

• No prior tolling or transportation experience required (helpful, but not necessary).

• A natural systems thinker: curious about how things connect, and comfortable pulling on a thread until an issue makes sense.

• Comfortable with technology and data:willing to work in spreadsheets, CRM records, and reports to find answers; basic Excel skills expected, more is a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts; able to break a complex issue into parts and reason through it methodically.

• Excellent time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities with strict attention to detail.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external customers.

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team.

• Continually contributes to a cohesive team environ

title: Growth Associate (all genders)
description:
Growth Associate (Munich)

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate. For decades, procurement teams have relied on spreadsheets, emails and fragmented processes to manage billions in spend. As AI agents take over increasingly complex workflows, that’s about to change.

As a Growth Associate, you open the first door into these accounts. You’re not just booking meetings: you’re creating the first impression of Lio. You’re the first conversation a CPO has with Lio, and you’re on the fast track to closing these deals yourself. You’ll work closely with founders, AEs, Marketing and Product, and directly influence how we scale our go-to-market.

Location: Munich, in office

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Find the right people in target accounts and start conversations that matter to them, through outbound and inbound

- Research accounts properly and write outreach that targets each persona’s real pain

- Build creative outreach strategies across email, LinkedIn and phone, and test what actually gets a CPO to respond

- Run qualification and hand opportunities to our AEs with the context they need to win

- Keep the CRM accurate, because you know that clean data today turns into a 7-figure deal later

- Share what you hear from customers with Product and Marketing, and help shape our messaging

- Help build and continuously improve Lio’s go-to-market playbook

WHO YOU ARE

- 1-3 years of experience in GTM: SDR, sales, business development or growth, or a related start in VC, consulting or a founder’s office

- Ownership by default: you don’t wait for instructions or permission, you make things happen

- Quality over quantity: you’d rather research an account properly than send 100 generic emails

- Persistence and consistency: a first “no” is where it starts, not where it ends. You also read the room and learn where to push and where to give space.

- Clear communication, so you build trust with senior stakeholders quickly and know how to create excitement, whether you’re talking to a Fortune 500 executive or a buyer on the factory floor

- Curiosity and speed: you learn new tools and topics fast, and you want to understand how big companies actually buy

- Attention to detail and ownership of your pipeline, from first touch to handoff

- You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and adapt quickly to AI-driven change

YOUR PATH

This is where your GTM journey starts. Hit your targets, and within about 12 months you’re an AE owning complex enterprise deals end to end. Along the way, you gain extensive GTM experience in scaling a startup in a high-paced environment. Bring SDR experience or overperform, and you get there faster.

WHY JOIN US

- Work on one of the most exciting applications of AI agents, in a category we’re defining

- Silicon Valley DNA, built in Europe: backed by a16z, with the same ambition, speed and culture, in Munich

- Exposure from day one to Fortune 500 companies and C-level procurement leaders running large-scale transformations

- A clear path to AE, with deal ownership and real responsibility early on

- A team that moves fast, values impact and gives you room to grow. No endless approval processes, no politics, no waiting for permission.

- Joining early: the category is still being defined and the playbook is still being written

- Competitive salary plus equity

Have questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Lisa https://www.linkedin.com/in/eazhadik/.

We are looking for a senior Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer with deep experience operating large-scale distributed systems and recent hands-on expertise in high-performance computing (HPC) and AI infrastructure. This is an operations-first SRE role, working in a 24/7/365 on-call environment, responsible for ensuring reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical infrastructure. This role sits within a cross-functional organisation spanning network engineering, infrastructure SRE, Platform SRE, infrastructure tooling engineers (software) and data centre operations.

The ideal candidate has progressed through large-scale, globally distributed or multi-site infrastructure environments and has more recently specialised in GPU-accelerated HPC systems. This role provides exposure to the latest high-density AI compute platforms, including next-generation GPU infrastructure at significant scale. You will bring strong breadth across bare metal, networking, storage, virtualisation, and orchestration, alongside deep HPC experience including NVIDIA GPU ecosystems, RDMA networking (RoCE and InfiniBand), and performance validation and benchmarking. You will work across hardware, network, and software layers to validate readiness of high-density GPU infrastructure and support safe, predictable deployment at scale.

You will also play a central role in continuous service improvement (CSI)-reducing operational toil, increasing automation, and improving reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the platform. This includes strengthening observability, refining operational workflows, and eliminating repetitive or failure-prone processes.

Over time, you will help shape future infrastructure design and deployment approaches, feeding operational insight back into infrastructure engineering decisions and ensuring production learnings directly influence next-generation HPC platform evolution.

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

title: Gestionnaire de l’expérience et de la formation en commerce de détail
description:
À propos de Cozey

Chez Cozey , nous cherchons à libérer le potentiel de votre maison et à rendre l’achat de meubles aussi simple et agréable que possible. Nos meubles élégants et réfléchis s’adaptent à l’évolution des modes de vie, alliant innovation, excellent rapport qualité-prix et service client exceptionnel. En tant que marque en pleine croissance, principalement en ligne, notre succès repose sur une équipe qui partage notre passion pour redéfinir l’expérience des meubles.

La mission du ou de la Gestionnaire de l’expérience et de la formation en commerce de détail chez Cozey

Relevant du Vice-président de la stratégie et des opérations de commerce de détail, vous façonnerez la manière dont nos équipes en magasin apprennent, dirigent et offrent une expérience client exceptionnelle.

Alors que Cozey continue d’élargir sa présence en magasin, vous bâtirez les programmes de coaching et de formation qui développeront des leaders confiant.e.s, rehausseront les comportements de vente et donneront vie à l’expérience de notre marque dans chacun de nos magasins. Une solide base de formation sur les produits est déjà en place. Vous vous concentrerez donc sur le développement de nos leaders en tant que coachs, sur la création d’une culture d’apprentissage continu et sur la transformation de la formation en résultats concrets.

Ce poste est en télétravail et ouvert partout au Canada. Vous devez résider près de l’un de nos magasins Cozey , soit à Edmonton, Calgary, Toronto, Montréal ou Vancouver, et prévoir environ 25 à 30 % de déplacements.

Ce que vous ferez

• Bâtir un programme de coaching évolutif qui permet aux gérant.e.s de magasin, aux gérant.e.s adjoint.e.s et aux détenteur.rice.s de clés de devenir de meilleur.e.s coachs, de donner de la rétroaction constructive et d’aborder les conversations difficiles avec assurance.

• Donner vie à la philosophie de vente de Cozey en traduisant les attentes en matière d’expérience client en comportements quotidiens qui renforcent le lien avec les client.e.s et rehaussent l’expérience en magasin.

• Concevoir des programmes, des outils et des ressources de développement du leadership et des ventes qui rendent l’apprentissage concret, mémorable et facile à appliquer sur le plancher de vente.

• Collaborer avec l’équipe Produit pour faire évoluer en continu la formation sur les produits et s’assurer que chaque membre de l’équipe possède les connaissances et l’assurance nécessaires pour parler de nos collections.

• Mesurer l’impact de l’apprentissage en suivant le taux d’achèvement des formations, la rétention des connaissances et la performance sur le plancher de vente, et utiliser ces constats pour améliorer continuellement les programmes.

• Vous rendre dans nos magasins pour coacher les leaders et les équipes sur le terrain, renforcer les meilleures pratiques et contribuer à de meilleurs résultats en magasin.

• Collaborer avec les équipes Opérations de détail, Marketing, Produit et Expérience client pour créer une expérience cohérente et connectée entre nos canaux numériques et nos magasins physiques.

• Bâtir des cadres de formation et de coaching évolutifs pour soutenir l’expansion de Cozey en commerce de détail, avec la possibilité de mettre sur pied et de diriger éventuellement une équipe de formation régionale.

Nous aimerions recevoir votre candidature si vous avez

• Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en commerce de détail, dont au moins 2 ans dans un rôle axé sur l’expérience client, la formation ou les opérations de détail.

• De l’expérience dans le développement de leaders et dans le coaching de gestionnaires sur la façon de diriger, de motiver et de faire grandir leurs équipes.

• Une solide compréhension de ce qui fait une excellente expérience de vente, ainsi que la capacité de traduire les normes d’expérience client en comportements quotidiens.

• De l’aisance à animer des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, que ce soit devant un groupe de leaders en magasin ou en coaching

title: Stage - Coordinateur administratif & opérations événementielles (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
description:
L'équipe Field Marketing & B2B Events crée des événements pour les professionnels de santé : congrès, événements propres et activations locales. Ils renforcent notre marque et soutiennent directement les équipes Sales. En rejoignant l'équipe, vous devenez le pilier opérationnel qui rend ces événements possibles : vous fiabilisez les inscriptions, la facturation et la logistique, et vous libérez du temps pour que l'équipe se concentre sur ce qui crée le plus de valeur. Vous participez aussi aux événements sur le terrain, comme membre à part entière de l'équipe.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

- Piloter les inscriptions aux événements : suivre les listes, relancer, mettre à jour les données et assurer le lien avec les équipes Sales.

- Gérer le cycle de facturation événementielle : bons de commande, suivi des factures fournisseurs, rapprochement avec le budget et relances.

- Gérer les commandes de goodies et de supports : demandes de devis, commandes, suivi des livraisons et des stocks.

- Structurer et fiabiliser nos process et nos documents : archivage, templates, tableaux de suivi, automatisation simple de tâches répétitives.

- Contribuer à l'événementiel : soutenir l'équipe sur site, participer aux événements et aider au suivi des résultats

 
 

LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES POUR CE POSTE

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si :

- Vous préparez un Bac+2 à Bac+5 (BTS ou BUT GEA, assistant manager, gestion administrative, commerce, événementiel).

- Vous êtes très rigoureux·se et à l'aise avec les chiffres, les tableaux de suivi et les documents administratifs.

- Vous savez gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle sans perdre de vue les échéances.

- Vous aimez le contact avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les partenaires.

- Vous maîtrisez Excel ou Google Sheets

Ce serait fantastique si :

- Vous avez déjà suivi une facturation ou un budget, même à petite échelle.

- Vous êtes curieux·se des outils d'automatisation et de gestion de données.

- Vous utilisez déjà l’IA au quotidien

 
 

NOTRE OFFRE

- Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

- Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux

- Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

- Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

- De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être

- Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride

- Un call RH avec Flore, Talent partner (15 minutes)

- Entretien opérationnel avec Laurianne, Event Manager 30 min

- Entretien final avec Judith, Head of Events, 15min

At Solventum , we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. The role serves as a senior commercial lead for assigned federal accounts and opportunities, developing trusted relationships with government customers, industry partners, and internal stakeholders while identifying and advancing opportunities across Solventum Health Information Systems.

· Build relationships that support customer satisfaction, retention, expansion, and long-term strategic partnership.
Business Development and Pipeline Growth
· Identify, qualify, develop, and advance federal opportunities that align customer mission requirements with Solventum capabilities.
· Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of near-, mid-, and long-term opportunities.
· Develop account and opportunity plans that identify customer needs, competitive landscape, acquisition path, partners, decision-makers, risks, and next actions.
· Identify expansion opportunities within existing customers while developing new federal business.
· Maintain accurate opportunity, forecast, and pipeline
